senses.gloss: [cmp. זוּד, to boil, fr. which סִיד lime; denom. סוּד or סִיד (b. h. שִׂיד),] to plaster, whitewash.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 7:5">Sot. VII, 5</cite> <he>סָדוּהוּ בסיד</he> they whitewashed it (the altar) with lime.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite> <he>שלא יָסוּד אדם וכ׳</he> that a person must not plaster his rooms &c.
Tosef. B. Bath. II, 17; B. Bath. 60ᵇ סָד אדם וכ׳ a man may plaster all his rooms &c.; a. e.—Esp. to paint the skin with a depilatory (of lime or orpiment).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:4">Sabb. VIII, 4</cite> <he>כדי לָסוּד וכ׳</he> as much as may be required for painting a little girl; <cite ref="Shabbat 80b:2">ib. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי לסוד אצבע וכ׳</he> to paint the little finger &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:20">Tosef. ib. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:20">IX</cite>), 20; a. e.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:7">Tosef. Sot. VIII, 7</cite> <he>וסִיְּידוּהוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="K00617"><he>כִּיר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:7">Ab. Zar. III, 7</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְסוּיָּיד</he>; f. <he>מְסוּיֶּידֶת</he>. Tosef. B. Bath. l. c.; B. Bath. l. c.; a. e.—[Incorr. <he>סייר</he> in some ed.]
